epics.title: Foundation: Database, Auth & Hosting Infrastructure
epics.description: Establish the foundational technology stack: PostgreSQL schema on Supabase with mandatory RLS, Supabase Auth with RBAC JWT claims, Next.js 15 project scaffolding, Vercel Edge deployment, and Upstash Redis rate limiting. All downstream Epics depend on this infrastructure layer.
acceptance_criteria: All 5 core tables (exams, notifications, draft_notifications, user_subscriptions, audit_logs) exist with correct types and constraints

JWT custom claims carry role information for RLS enforcement
Next.js 15 project builds with zero TypeScript/ESLint errors
Vercel deployment pipeline functional with preview and production branches
Upstash Redis rate limiter operational on public API routes
